===== BEGIN H39_design.txt =====
H39 frozen 2026-11-19 00:05:43 UTC. Incremental FINAL Job25 count16 patch SHA256 fa67a78ffc6646c231bb30960b8ab574f2c6a2a80dc38a8816779ef6b83518cd.
Exact site Worker::rework_entry: original r15d reads precomputed threat_maps[ply].by_type; optimized uses lazy threat_set_for_piece. One use per actual rework_entry invocation. Capture readiness before actual read, execute actual read once, independently rebuild old unconditional enemy pawn/minor/rook attack unions from current Board without calling instrumented lesser_threats. Select full reference mask by moving piece type and compare with consumed mask. Full mask equality implies matching from/to threat bits used for history-cell indexing; no history write or second reference-cell mutation.
Classes White/Black, pawnminor/rook/queen/kingempty, ready/unready are independent partitions. WRONG17 toggles bit0 of private expected mask only White, actual mask/index/table reference unchanged. Existing H42/H47 reader hooks remain unchanged and may still record their own scoped events. No added H71 or other old hook in reference.
Shares attack primitives/formulas and Board representation; compares old eager semantics with current consumed lazy mask, not independent legality. Readiness class is attribution metadata, not the oracle. Does not cover direct fastquiet by_type reads missed by H47, nor all history updates or lifetime/invalidation mechanisms. H47 gap remains explicit. No native counted runs by this worker.
Control limitation: toggled bit0 may not be either move endpoint, so the fault proves full-mask comparison sensitivity, not guaranteed selected-history-index corruption. Readiness denotes entry ready-state, not proof the helper used cache: type-specific fast paths may bypass storage. Equality of full masks entails endpoint-bit/index equality; no second table lookup is needed for that implication.

 // B4 HistRework (forge/r9): the twin's slot of a quiet move at the node of `ss`, whose lesser-attacker maps are
 // threat_maps_[ss->ply] (set before every move picker that scores quiet moves while the option is on).
 std::int16_t& Worker::rework_entry(const Board& board, const SearchStack* ss, Move move) const {
+#if FORGE_SHORTCUT_COUNT
+    const bool h39_ready=threat_map_ready_[static_cast<std::size_t>(ss->ply)]!=0;
+#endif
     const Bitboard set = threat_set_for_piece(board, ss->ply, piece_type(board.moved_piece(move)));
 #if FORGE_SHORTCUT_COUNT
+    const Color h39_them=opposite(board.side_to_move());
+    const Bitboard h39_occ=board.occupied();
+    const Bitboard h39_pawn=pawn_attacks_bb(h39_them,board.pieces(h39_them,Pawn));
+    Bitboard h39_minor=h39_pawn;
+    for(Bitboard bb=board.pieces(h39_them,Knight);bb;)h39_minor|=attacks::knight(pop_lsb(bb));
+    for(Bitboard bb=board.pieces(h39_them,Bishop);bb;)h39_minor|=attacks::bishop(pop_lsb(bb),h39_occ);
+    Bitboard h39_rook=h39_minor;
+    for(Bitboard bb=board.pieces(h39_them,Rook);bb;)h39_rook|=attacks::rook(pop_lsb(bb),h39_occ);
+    const int h39_pt=piece_type(board.moved_piece(move));
+    Bitboard h39_ref=(h39_pt==King||h39_pt==NoPieceType)?0:(h39_pt==Queen?h39_rook:(h39_pt==Rook?h39_minor:h39_pawn));
+#if FORGE_SHORTCUT_WRONG17
+    if(board.side_to_move()==White)h39_ref^=Bitboard{1};
+#endif
+    const int h39_group=h39_pt==Rook?1:(h39_pt==Queen?2:((h39_pt==King||h39_pt==NoPieceType)?3:0));
+    shortcut_count::record_h39(set!=h39_ref,board.side_to_move()==White,h39_group,h39_ready,board,move);
+#endif
+#if FORGE_SHORTCUT_COUNT
     h42_consume(board,ss->ply,piece_type(board.moved_piece(move)),set,2);
     h47_consume(board,ss->ply,piece_type(board.moved_piece(move)),set,2);
 #endif

===== BEGIN H20_design.txt =====
H20 actual consumer: old r15d Evasions branch selects untagged move, skips TT then rejects absent from legal_to_by_from; current branch rejects Move::none tags or TT. One use per actually consumed pick_best slot in tied-fallback Evasions only, including skipped slots, not one per returned move or full generation.
Private shadow retains existing H30 untagged pseudo Move+score snapshot and from/to legality mask without extra generation/scoring/hooks. Each actual pick is followed by independent old scalar strict earliest-highest first4 selection, then one score-only std::sort of remaining shadow tail. Compare actual skip decision (None or TT) with old deferred-mask decision, compare score at every consumed slot, and all Move fields for accepted slots. Promotion identity/flags are retained; legality mask deliberately keeps old from/to-only semantics rather than upgrading to an independent chess-law oracle. Actual generation/pick/return executes unchanged once.
Unlike H30 projected full sequence, H20 observes only reached consumer prefix. Unconsumed suffix is not counted; exhaustion without another slot is not an extra use. Non-tied optimized legal-only evasions and EvasionTT stage are outside this new counter. Shadow shares generator/scoring inputs and std::sort implementation; scalar selection is independent of actual SIMD selector. Old H25 selector counter remains unchanged; no extra actual pick invocation.
Classes White/Black, actual None/TT/returned, reference legal/illegal and promotion/nonpromotion independently partition uses. Reference legal means membership of old deferred from/to mask, not full independent legality. WRONG17 flips only private expected-skip Boolean on White-to-move slots. No actual skip/Move/score modified. Old29 counters and canonical final-info except time/nps must remain exact. Shadow vector is diagnostic local storage only; no published position/move dataset.

===== END H20_design.txt =====

===== BEGIN H20_cross_review.txt =====
H20 read-only cross-review 2026-11-19 00:07 UTC.
Opened staged Evasions consumer, h20_consume and shadow initialization; original r15d pick_best scalar/SIMD first maximum and tail sort. Actual pick executes once, diagnostic reads stored selected score at index-1. Private untagged shadow advances one slot with scalar strict-first-max selection first4 then same score std::sort. It uses preexisting H30 original scores and legality mask, no extra scoring/generation or oldhook.
Compare skip decision actual None/TT versus old TT/deferred legal mask. Scores compared every consumed slot; full from/to/promotion/flags compared only accepted actual move. Missing reference is difference. White-only private expected-skip flip leaves actual values unchanged. Skipped actual None need not equal old pseudo move identity, which is intentional representation change.
Scope only reached/consumed tied-fallback slots, not unconsumed suffix after cutoff. Shares scoring, legality-mask generation and sort comparator with other diagnostics; not independent legality or full order proof beyond observed slots. H30 projected full sequence and H20 actual-consumer scope differ. No source edits or native runs in review.
